title: Exclude inherited P104 public four-MOVE recharts (0% κ change)
body:
## Result and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact #7334 `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`, both independent walks match all nine inherited public-helper ADDs and their four incident paid MOVE clocks. In each case the low-chart union and high-chart intersection equal the old rank-four midpoint. The priced rank-five replacement is therefore impossible. All nine cases are resolved.

The independently reproduced comparator is conditional κ = 0.00364665195644 with exact signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. The complete directed upper is about 0.05315269560459226 raw for one edit and 0.39474780129390424 raw for the nine-key matching before ancillary charges. The compatible saving in scope is zero.

## Task and overlap

Changed scope of `p104-side-correction`, revision 8, on canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Retain the four paid clocks and outer charts and try to redistribute paid rank around one common public ADD. The keys come from the exact #7277 ancestry. #7337 checks the mixed public/owned motif and #7312 checks common-lift fusion. Newly created current-word shapes and changed outer routes remain open.

## Replay and verification

Use CPython 3.12 with assertions and the standard library from a clean checkout:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-public-four-move-rechart-bound/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-public-four-move-rechart-bound
```

Both literal walks, exact prices and three input mutation controls replayed locally. Registered, committed byte/mode/source-history, navigation and official Git-free checks passed. The branch carries the existing #7257 onboarding repair. No candidate reached the native or outer proof gates.

## Credit and next question

#7277, #7334 and #7113 supply the source words and caller. #7312, #7319 and #7339 supply contact and role evidence. #7298 supplies directed arithmetic. #7337, #7297, #7122 and #7325 are related methods. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted. A new contact signature or changed outer route needs its own complete price and exact contact gate.
